question: What does consciousness withdraw in this phase of reabsorption?
premises: Consciousness devours the wheel of rays consisting of faculties and parts of awareness.
This devouring occurs within the self.
It withdraws the suns situated in the measure-part.
inference: In reabsorption, consciousness draws the radiant cognitive faculties and their measuring lights back into itself.
uncertainties: The metaphorical referents of the rays and suns are not explicitly identified in this verse.
plain_english: Thus, devouring within itself the wheel of rays made of the faculties and portions of awareness, consciousness withdraws the suns that stand in the part of measurement.
